scope.phase: measurement acquisition and data quality before calibration
forbidden_actions: root-only collection as an unstated dependency
copy planning defaults into missing measurements

selected.name: Signal Collector
hardware: SIM/eSIM and operator permission as required by the campaign

root_requirement.documented_mode: not required by the documented standard handset export
root_requirement.audit_rule: record the actual device and reject the run if it silently depends on root or privileged modem access

export.raw_preservation: keep the original bytes and SHA-256 separately from canonical JSON

semantics: The V6 payload is an escaped key=value list separated by semicolons; the adapter decodes the nested grammar after decoding the TSV envelope.
The documented NR shared snapshot uses ss_rsrp/ss_rsrq/ss_sinr; generic RSSI is not relabeled as RSRP.
LTE bandwidth is exported in kHz in the documented field; the adapter converts only that explicit field to MHz.
A missing NR bandwidth/resource field remains missing even when the transmitter map has configured planning bandwidth.
Only registered PRIMARY_SERVING and SECONDARY_SERVING rows become serving observations; raw unregistered neighbor rows are retained as context and never selected by strength.
selected.automation: manual start/stop and local export; export checksum and session metadata are captured by the campaign runner
selected.privacy: local-first export is kept under campaign custody; exclude subscriber/device personal identifiers from the canonical record and restrict raw access
selected.licensing: verify the app/export terms and operator/site/participant permissions for the actual pilot; the repository fixture is synthetic and carries no field-data license claim
limitations: NR bandwidth/resource metadata is not guaranteed by the selected V6 export, so 28 GHz RSRP and radio-quality readiness may remain blocked.
Handset modem values are source-declared measurements, not automatically calibrated absolute received power.
A complete SINR/RSRQ/RSSI evaluation still needs auditable serving/resource/neighbor context and compatible canonical radio-quality inputs.
The collector does not by itself establish transmitter height, azimuth, tilt, or exact planning-cell truth.

alternatives.name: CellMapper standard CSV
alternatives.root_requirement: not required for the ordinary app mode; verify actual device behavior
missing_or_ambiguous: standard CSV has no timestamp column
standard CSV does not provide the required RSRQ/SINR context
signal meaning differs by radio type
standard CSV does not establish complete antenna/calibration provenance

alternatives.name: Android native CellInfo collector
alternatives.root_requirement: standard TelephonyManager APIs are available, but field/device/operator support varies
missing_or_ambiguous: requires building and maintaining a collection app
GNSS synchronization, raw preservation, and export provenance must be implemented by the campaign team

alternatives.name: Engineering/modem logs or Network Cell Info style exports
alternatives.root_requirement: unknown until the exact handset, firmware, modem interface, and export path are tested

alternatives.name: CellTraceLogger
quantities: cell identity and modem measurements according to the project implementation
missing_or_ambiguous: the audited project export does not provide the complete GPS/timestamp/transmitter-map contract required here without additional campaign code

decision.selected_mode: handset field measurement with Signal Collector V6 plus an independent transmitter truth map
decision.phase_2_escalation: use a native CellInfo/custom engineering collector only if a target device cannot export the required V6 fields or if NR resource metadata remains unavailable
